name: Iron Ore
description: A rough chunk of iron ore pulled from shallow veins. Used in basic forging.

name: Wood Plank
description: A cut and dried plank of hardwood. Reliable stock for handles and staves.

name: Leather Scrap
description: A cured scrap of hide used to wrap grips and reinforce joints.

name: Beast Hide
description: Thick hide taken from a dungeon beast. Tougher than standard leather.

name: Monster Fang
description: A serrated fang snapped from a monster's jaw. Sharp enough to be worked into a blade edge.

name: Silver Ore
description: Gleaming ore with a faint magical resonance. Used to forge weapons that resist dark energy.

name: Arcane Essence
description: Condensed magical energy in crystalline form. Drawn from deep dungeon nodes.

name: Dragon Scale
description: An iridescent scale shed by a dungeon wyrm. Incredibly hard and heat-resistant.

name: Mythril Ore
description: A pale, feather-light ore with extraordinary tensile strength. Prized by master smiths.

name: Ancient Rune
description: A stone fragment inscribed with pre-Astral script. Still vibrates with the original enchantment.

name: Phoenix Feather
description: A feather from a dimensional phoenix. Perpetually warm and faintly luminous.

name: Void Crystal
description: A black crystal formed where the void has eaten through reality. Channels destructive energy.

name: Diamond Ore
description: A brilliant crystalline ore harder than any natural stone. Holds a razor edge indefinitely.

name: Astral Shard
description: A sliver of crystallised astral plane. Each one took centuries to form.

name: Celestial Ore
description: Ore that fell from beyond the known dimensions. Its metallic hum never fully stops.

name: Eternity Dust
description: Fine dust left behind when something immortal finally dies. Imbues weapons with timeless power.

name: Titanium Ore
description: An impossibly dense ore pulled from the deepest dungeon veins. The pinnacle of mundane forging material.

name: Wood
description: Rough-cut timber. The first thing any empire needs and the last thing it stops needing.

name: Stone
description: Quarried building stone. Heavy, plain, and the foundation of every wall ever raised.

name: Iron
description: Smelted iron ready for construction. Turns a shack into a stronghold.

name: Plank
description: Wood refined into true planks. Cleaner, stronger, and worth the extra work.

name: Brick
description: Fired clay brick. Stacks fast and holds a city together.

name: Iron Ingot
description: A dense bar of purified iron. The stuff of gates, engines, and empires that last.

name: Hardwood
description: Dense, slow-grown timber prized for great halls and warships alike.

name: Granite
description: Speckled, unbreakable stone. What you build from granite, you build to outlive you.

name: Steel
description: Iron mastered by fire and carbon. The line between a fortress and a legend.
